define_roles.description: Establish a standardized catalog of organizational positions.
key_features: Hierarchical Structure: Define Seniority levels (Junior, Mid, Senior, Lead).
Competency Benchmarking: Map specific proficiency requirements to each role.
Functional Grouping: Categorize roles by department (Engineering, Sales, Operations).
Inheritance: Allow sub-roles to inherit skill requirements from parent roles.

define_skills.description: Create a granular inventory of technical and soft competencies.
key_features: Multi-level Proficiency: Define L1 (Beginner) through L4 (Expert) criteria for each skill.
Validation Logic: Link skills to specific assessments or external certifications for verification.
Skill Clusters: Group related skills into competency clusters (e.g., 'Data Science' contains 'Python', 'Stats', 'R').
Weightage Influence: Assign base weights to skills based on organizational priority.

define_tags.description: Enable cross-functional metadata for discovery and analytics.
key_features: Hot Skill Indicators: Tag high-demand skills to trigger specialized leaderboards.
Domain Categorization: Tagging for industries (e.g., #OilAndGas, #Renewables) or technologies (e.g., #Cloud, #AI).
Searchability: Powering the RMT search engine for faster resource identification.
Global Consistency: Maintain a curated library to prevent duplicate or synonymous tag creation.

business_impact: Eliminates data silos across different business units.
Ensures automated resumes reflect verified, standardized terminology.
Facilitates AI-driven content generation by providing a clear structural target.
Enables precise gap analysis at a project and unit level.
